entities.name: Louis-Antoine-François de Marchangy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Antoine François de Marchangy was a French lawyer, author and politician. He was a passionate supporter first of Napoleon and later of the Bourbons, and an impressive force in the courtroom. He was a Deputy from 1822 to 1824.
